fusions.name: Thrashed Shallows
fusions.desc: A sweeping strike that deals 12 damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles and knocks each back 3 tiles, with a 50% chance to leave it [Soaked] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Undertow
fusions.desc: Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health. A clamping strike that deals 18 damage, uses up every affliction on the target and adds 1.5 times their remaining damage, and leaves it [Enervated] for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Mudbank
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 25% for 12 seconds, and you move 15% faster for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Basking Count
fusions.desc: After 8 seconds without a critical hit, your critical hit chance rises by 40% for your next strike. Once every 8 seconds. You regenerate 0.5 health a second.
